output_list.reason: The 'distributeFUD' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check 'sufficientFunds && !overflowed' is flawed, allowing overflow. The 'overflowed' condition is incorrect, allowing overflow. An attacker can set _value to a very large value, causing balances[_to] to wrap from a large value to zero, granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check 'sufficientFunds && !overflowed' is flawed, allowing overflow. An attacker can set _value to a very large value, causing balances[_to] to wrap from a large value to zero, granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check 'sufficientFunds && sufficientAllowance && !overflowed' is flawed, allowing overflow. An attacker can set _value to a very large value, causing balances[_to] to wrap from a large value to zero, granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The check 'allowed[msg.sender][_spender] != 0' is flawed, allowing overflow. An attacker can set _value to a very large value, causing allowed[_owner][msg.sender] to wrap from a large value to zero, granting arbitrary tokens to the attacker.
The Typo Constructor function is exploitable due to a typo in the 'initialSupply' variable assignment, causing it to be set to zero, allowing attackers to steal funds.
